# What cjw_multisite is made of

This page takes `cjw_multisite` apart: which packages it consists of, what each folder holds, and which file the
setup calls when. It is for developers who want to change the package or build one like it, and for administrators
who want to know what lands in `var/storage/packages/7x/`. Every file named here is in the source repository
[se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage) and in the imported copies
of an installation.

## The packages at a glance

| Package | Type | Install type | Holds | Archive size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cjw_multisite` | `site` | `import` | Thumbnail, logo, license, seven settings files and their two helpers | 97,634 bytes |
| `cjw_multisite_democontent` | `contentobject` | `install` | 40 class definitions, 138 object files, four side files | 169,949 bytes |
| `sevenx_classes` | `contentclass` | (its own) | The base classes, shared with `sevenx_multisite` | see [sevenx_classes](../sevenx-multisite/sevenx-classes.md) |

Sizes are the `content-length` of the files under
`https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/`. The content package is small because it
carries no images: its 158 `<simple-file>` entries point into the extension (see
[What is outside the packages](#what-is-outside-the-packages)).

## The site package cjw_multisite

```text
packages/cjw_multisite/
  package.xml
  documents/LICENCE
  files/default/thumbnail/thumbnail.png
  files/default/image/logo.png
  settings/ini-site.php
  settings/ini-admin.php
  settings/ini-common.php
  settings/cjw-multi-site-installer.php
  settings/install-scripts.php
  settings/roles.php
  settings/preferences.php
  settings/post-install-fix.php
  settings/cjw-starter-install.php
```

The parts of `package.xml` that matter:

```xml
<dependencies>
  <requires>
    <require type="ezpackage" name="sevenx_classes" min-version="5.1" />
    <require type="ezpackage" name="cjw_multisite_democontent" min-version="5.1" />
  </requires>
</dependencies>
<settings>
  <settings-file filename='ini-site.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='ini-admin.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='ini-common.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='cjw-multi-site-installer.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='install-scripts.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='roles.php'/>
  <settings-file filename='preferences.php'/>
</settings>
<install />
<uninstall />
```

The site package has no install items of its own (`<install />` is empty). Its `<files>` list names the thumbnail
and the logo with their MD5 sums; the logo is set on the template look object at the end of the install. The
maintainer and changelog entries carry the name "Administrator User" and a maintainer e-mail.

## The settings files and who calls them

Each listed settings file defines one function with a fixed name; the setup's create sites step looks for these
names (see [Install scripts in a site package](../basics/install-scripts-in-a-site-package.md)). Every one of them
only creates a `cjwMultiSiteInstaller` and hands over:

| File | Function | Calls |
|---|---|---|
| `ini-site.php` | `eZSiteINISettings( $parameters )` | `siteINISettings()`: menu, override, toolbar, site, image, content, template, content structure menu and ODF settings of the user siteaccess |
| `ini-admin.php` | `eZSiteAdminINISettings( $parameters )` | `adminINISettings()` |
| `ini-common.php` | `eZSiteCommonINISettings( $parameters )` | `commonINISettings()`: the `settings/override` files |
| `install-scripts.php` | `eZSitePreInstall()` and `eZSitePostInstall( &$parameters )` | `preInstall()` before the packages, `postInstall()` after them |
| `roles.php` | `eZSiteRoles( $parameters )` | `siteRoles()` |
| `preferences.php` | `eZSitePreferences( $parameters )` | `sitePreferences()` |
| `cjw-multi-site-installer.php` | none | Defines `class cjwMultiSiteInstaller extends eZSiteInstaller` (5,939 lines) |

`post-install-fix.php` and `cjw-starter-install.php` are not in the `<settings>` list. The installer loads them with
`require_once` at its top:

```php
require_once dirname( __FILE__ ) . '/post-install-fix.php';
require_once dirname( __FILE__ ) . '/cjw-starter-install.php';
```

`post-install-fix.php` (593 lines) says of itself that it was generated from the 7x MultiSite installer's helpers by
renaming `sevenx*` functions to `cjw*`, "so both files can never meet as one declaration", and leaving out what only
the 7x demo content needs. `cjw-starter-install.php` (827 lines) holds the steps of the starter content. Both are
described in [The installer scripts](the-installer-scripts.md).

## The content package cjw_multisite_democontent

```text
packages/cjw_multisite_democontent/
  package.xml
  documents/LICENCE
  ezcontentclass/class-<identifier>.xml     40 files
  ezcontentobject/contentobjects.xml
  ezcontentobject/object-cjw-starter-o-*.xml  138 files
  cjw-class-additions.xml
  cjw-explayouts.json
  cjw-paths.json
  cjw-starter-import.json
```

Its `<install>` list has 40 `ezcontentclass` items and one `ezcontentobject` item (`contentobjects`); its
`<uninstall>` list removes the objects again. The four side files are not install items: the kernel's package
handlers never read them, the site package's installer does. Details in
[The demo content package](the-demo-content-package.md).

## What is outside the packages

| What | Where | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| The images (155 entries) and files (3 entries) of the starter content | `extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/content-images/`, `share/content-files/` | `cjwLinkStarterFilesFromExtension()` before the packages install |
| The design `starter` and its settings | `extension/cjw_themes_jumper/` | the user siteaccesses at run time |
| The TMV event feed (optional) | `extension/cjw_tmv/` | left out of the extension list when the folder is not there |
| The schemas of the extensions | `extension/<name>/share/db_schema.dba` | `extensionSchemas()` in `preInstall()` |
| The default admin layouts | `extension/explayouts/share/fragments/admin_layouts_db_data.dba` | `postInstallImportAdminLayouts()` |

The 158 simple-file entries name 77 distinct files in the extension; the 6.0.15 copy of the extension holds 74 images
and 3 files in those two folders.

## The source repository

[se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage) is "laid out as the 7x
package repository" (its first commit):

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `packages/cjw_multisite/`, `packages/cjw_multisite_democontent/` | The two packages, unpacked |
| `bin/pack.sh` | Packs every folder under `packages/` (except `package_set`) with `tar -cz` into `<name>.ezpkg` in `--output-dir` |
| `bin/repack_extension.sh`, `bin/ezpxmlextfilelist.php`, `ant/` | Helpers carried over from the 7x package repository |
| `.github/FUNDING.yml` | The funding links of the repository |

`pack.sh` leaves out version control folders and files (`.git`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `.gitmodules`,
`.svn`, `.hg`), editor and system leftovers (`.DS_Store`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `*~`, `*.swp`), `node_modules`,
`.cache` and `pack_and_publish.bat` (the commit of 2026-10-14). Pass `--output-dir`; the script's default is a
directory under `/tmp`.

```bash
cd cjw_multisite-ezpackage
sh bin/pack.sh --output-dir=../build
tar -tzf ../build/cjw_multisite.ezpkg | head
```

How a rebuilt archive reaches the package server is described in
[How a release reaches the package server](../package-server/how-a-release-reaches-the-package-server.md).
